body: Data-quality audit found secwatch/processor/prwatch/prwatch-body had been down since 2026-06-17 (~29 days) -- only read-side services were restarted in the earlier post-reboot recovery. Restarted all four with production flags (secwatch: watchlist+5m poll+2rps matching ops/systemd/fatbaby-secwatch.service; processor: 4 workers+15s poll matching its unit; prwatch/prwatch-body: defaults, no systemd unit existed for these two previously). Confirmed alive via ps, prwatch already discovered 25 new items and prwatch-body cleared its backlog batch (512, 0 new) within the first minute. processor confirmed configured for real haiku classification (provider=haiku model=claude-haiku-4-5-20251001), addressing the audit's stub-data concern once new filings flow through. Founder confirmed restart via AskUserQuestion.
title: Restarted core ingestion after 29-day outage (secwatch/processor/prwatch/prwatch-body)
